story.introText: Ranani Niedzielski Glazer was born in Porto Alegre, Brazil, in October 1999 to Tatiana and David Ronen. He was the beloved brother of Reuven and Elad, Aharon, Avishai, Aryeh, and Baruch.
story.gremioText: Growing up in Porto Alegre, Ranani loved his local soccer team “Grêmio”. But above all, he loved his Parents and his family in Israel — so much that at just sixteen, after many years of effort, he made Aliyah alone to join them.
story.armyText: At twenty, he enlisted in the IDF as a Lone Soldier, serving first in the Carmel Company at Mahave Alon Base, then in the elite Golani Brigade. His commanders remembered him as “an amazing soldier, funny, determined to give everything he could to the State of Israel he loved so much.”
story.musicText: Ranani’s friends say he was incredibly talented and always eager to help others. He was known for his huge smile, his art, his music, his dancing — and for dreaming of becoming a DJ. He filled every room with light and laughter.
story.novaText: On that terrible Saturday, October 7th, 2023, Ranani was at the Nova Festival near Kibbutz Re’im, celebrating life and music under the stars. When the attack began at dawn, he and his friends tried to escape — but were caught in a shelter. He was murdered there, alongside so many whose only “crime” was dancing freely.
story.goodbyeText: After two agonizing days, his family received the devastating news. He was laid to rest at Tel Regev cemetery, just two days before his 24th birthday — surrounded by loved ones.
story.fatherQuote: “My Nani, you came to this country with your own strength... We lost a son, but the People of Israel gained a pure, holy soul.” — His father
story.brotherQuote: “Now you are there, above the dance floor of heaven, dancing among the angels...” — His brother Reuven
story.finalLine: May his memory be a blessing — forever dancing under the stars.
